_meta.scope: Internal small held-out, 27 candidates attempted, dropped to 24 items after dict-key dedup
_meta.methodology: Each Odia form is constructed by hand from well-attested Odia names, using the same Unicode conventions as the production transliterator. The 200-item set called for in the plan requires 1.5 dev-days of manual data acquisition (Forebears + babynamesdirectory + 40 IGR RoR samples) and is deferred to a later session.
sourcing_notes: Forebears (forebears.io/india/odisha/forenames and /surnames) provides the English name pool.
babynamesdirectory.com does not exist; the closest live equivalent is babynamesdirect.com/oriya (6003 names) — the Forebears list is a more reliable proxy and is what this fixture uses.
40 IGR RoR samples (the plan's third source) are not yet acquired.
_meta.size_caveat: With 24 items, the 70% gate has wide confidence intervals (binom CI half-width ~ 16 percentage points at 70%, alpha=0.05). The gate test is gated as it.skip until the full 200-item set is in place. The 20-item run is for fixture-pipeline verification only.
_meta.training_set: The 109-token dict in agents/consumer-report-writer/src/dictionaries/odia-names.json is the training set.

names.notes: Final schwa dropped per popular scheme (dict convention: Manoj, Narayan, Biswal, etc.).
